# Ni Bin Guy

Professional wheelie bin cleaning across Bangor, Newtownards, Donaghadee, Comber, Millisle, Ballywalter, Portaferry, Portavogie, Cloughey, Ballyhalbert and surrounding areas throughout County Down, Northern Ireland.

## Services

- Regular domestic wheelie bin cleaning
- One-off domestic wheelie bin cleaning
- Commercial bin cleaning
- Cleaning for 120L, 240L, 360L, 660L and 1100L bins
- Bin sanitising and deodorising
- Removal of dirt, waste residue, bacteria and unpleasant odours

## Service Areas

- Bangor
- Newtownards
- Donaghadee
- Comber
- Millisle
- Ballywalter
- Portaferry
- Portavogie
- Cloughey
- Ballyhalbert
- Surrounding areas throughout County Down

Customers in nearby areas can contact Ni Bin Guy to confirm availability.

## Business Information

Ni Bin Guy is a professional wheelie bin cleaning service based in Bangor, County Down, Northern Ireland.

Regular domestic cleaning starts from GBP 5 per bin. One-off domestic cleans start from GBP 15. Commercial prices depend on bin size and cleaning frequency.
